angles.drive: You spot openings before they open, and spotting is the pleasure. Since spotting first is how you feel safe, you put the far chance ahead of the near work. You pay with more openings spotted than finished, and one finish would settle that.

You start fast, and often. You find the first move costs nothing and feels like proof, so you take a new start rather than a slow middle. Start half as often and you are still first, with a week left over for finishing.

You give freely, and before anyone asks. You carry keeping as a weight and giving as a movement, so you hand things on sooner than you take them in. Give for as long as it feels like you, and keep back one thing.

You are always moving on, and the moving feels like being alive. You feel staying long enough to be known is giving up, and you move on ahead of the finish. Remember that moving on costs you the one thing you had started to build.

You spread yourself thin on purpose. You know a single venture would ask for all you have, so you spread yourself over a handful rather than wholly into one. Do not forget that thin shares of you add up to less than one whole one.

You spend it all because it came easily. You feel keeping money is admitting the next windfall is not coming, so you spend it rather than protect against that. Hold on to the fact that you spend the windfall faster than you earn the wage.

Value flashes at you from clutter. The underpriced watch in the junk tray, the mispriced listing at midnight, the talented kid in the noisy audition: your eye sorts faster than markets do, and the gap between seeing and everyone-else-seeing is where your margins live.

Your presentation is machined smooth. The shoes, the phrasing, the follow-up note: every surface catches light, and doors open on the shine before your substance says a word. People assume expensive training. It is actually maintenance, done privately, to standards nobody imposed but you.

New territory pulls you the way bargains pull collectors. The unlisted trail, the menu with no translation, the market nobody in your industry has priced: you go first, pay the entry costs cheerfully, and return with either treasure or material. Both spend well at dinner.

Every relationship carries a price tag only you can see. The friendship with useful contacts, the favor with its invoice pre-drafted, the warmth calibrated to net worth: your attention follows value with an honesty that would be refreshing if anyone enjoyed being an asset.

Every deal within reach gets reached for. The marketplace find, the estate sale, the friend selling below value: your hands close on opportunities by reflex, and your storage fills with the proof. Each grab was genuinely smart. The appetite behind them has never once said enough.

Stillness costs you more than motion. The good position gets abandoned at its plateau, the profitable arrangement gets renegotiated out of boredom, the sure thing loses to the next thing on novelty alone. Your escape velocity is magnificent. Your orbits never complete.
